name: UptimeRobot
summary: UptimeRobot's free plan covers 50 monitors checked every 5 minutes and allows commercial use. Paid plans add checks every minute or faster, up to four monitoring regions and SMS credits, at prices that change with the visitor's region.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: UptimeRobot sets prices by the visitor's region. We list the US dollar prices in an archived copy of its pricing page from November 2, 2026; on November 3 the live page showed us Solo at $9 a month on annual billing.
UptimeRobot's terms in December 2024 limited the free plan to personal, non-commercial use.
The current terms say UptimeRobot is available for any use, including commercial and business use.
Paid monitors can run from up to four regions: North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Monitors without a chosen region are checked from North America.
UptimeRobot confirms a downtime with extra checks from a different data center in the same region before alerting.
UptimeRobot reported false downtime alerts from its EU monitoring region on August 1, 2025, and a second incident with the same causes on August 16.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50 monitors at 5-minute intervals, 1 status page, no login seats

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: $13 on monthly billing. 10 monitors at 60-second intervals

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $46 on monthly billing. 100 monitors at 30-second intervals and 3 login seats

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $98 on monthly billing. 200 monitors at 15-second intervals

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Price on request. Adds SAML single sign-on

hiddenCosts: SMS and voice credits are one-time packs from $3 for 10 credits to $100 for 1,000, and a voice call uses 2 credits.
Extra login seats on Team cost $15 a month on annual billing or $19 monthly.
Visitors in different regions see different prices; the live page showed us lower dollar prices than the archived copy we list.

contract.cancellation: Turning off auto-renewal ends the plan at the close of the billing cycle, and new subscriptions have a 14-day money-back guarantee.
contract.dataExport: Logs as CSV from the dashboard, plus a REST API with uptime ratios and response times.
